description:
Host an image or video on Schedulala's CDN and get back a stable URL plus a media id for posting. Two modes (provide exactly one of url / data):

1. url — a publicly reachable http(s) source (a web image, an expiring link, a generated image URL). The server downloads and validates it. Limits: images up to 20 MB (jpeg, png, webp; gif up to 15 MB), videos up to 50 MB (mp4, mov, webm). For videos LARGER than 50 MB, skip this tool and pass the public URL directly in create_post's mediaItems; media is fetched at publish time.

2. data — base64-encoded file contents, LAST RESORT for tiny generated images only. IMPORTANT: when the user attached a photo or video in the conversation, or has a file on their device, do NOT read and base64 it yourself — chat channels truncate large payloads, forcing destructive compression (a 6MB photo becomes a 6KB thumbnail). Call attach_media instead: it opens an upload widget in the conversation and preserves full quality for images up to 20MB and videos up to 500MB. If the base64 exceeds ~8000 characters, do not send it inline - use begin_generated_media_upload instead.

Then pass the returned url into create_post's mediaItems, e.g. mediaItems: [{ type: "image", url: "<returned url>" }]. The real file type is detected from the file contents. Re-hosted media expires after 30 days if unused.

altText.description: Alt text stored with the media (recommended for images).

data.description: Base64-encoded file contents (small images only, 3MB max decoded). Provide url OR data, not both.

fileName.description: File name to store under. Defaults to the URL's basename.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the inline data (e.g. image/png). Required when data is provided.

type.description: Optional hint; the server verifies the real file type from the bytes.

url.description: Publicly reachable http(s) URL of the source image or video to re-host. Provide url OR data, not both.

name: upload_media
title: Upload Media
